mapper.sql: p.purchase_id, p.title, p.applicant_id, p.applicant_name, u.nick_name as applicant_nick_name, p.applicant_dept_id, applicant_dept.dept_name as applicant_dept_name, p.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, p.amount, p.reason, p.status, p.approval_instance_id, p.approval_round, p.row_version, p.last_approval_event_key, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark

from oa_purchase p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.applicant_id left join sys_dept applicant_dept on applicant_dept.dept_id = p.applicant_dept_id left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = p.shop_dept_id
mapper.insert: insert into oa_purchase ( title, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_dept_id, shop_dept_id, amount, reason, status, approval_instance_id, approval_round, row_version, last_approval_event_key, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{title}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{applicantDeptId}, #{shopDeptId}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{approvalInstanceId}, coalesce(#{approvalRound}, 0), 0, #{lastApprovalEventKey}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update:
update oa_purchase
title = #{title}, shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId}, amount = #{amount}, reason = #{reason}, status = #{status}, approval_instance_id = #{approvalInstanceId}, approval_round = #{approvalRound},
last_approval_event_key = #{lastApprovalEventKey},
update_by = #{updateBy}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = sysdate(), row_version = row_version + 1
where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and row_version = #{rowVersion}
